Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: 2-week pilot extension + engineering help?

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the run so far — the team has been iterating on prompts and the model behavior is improving. We hit a couple of integration snags this week (prefix caching mismatch + a telemetry hook issue) and would like to request a short extension to the timeboxed pilot so we can validate the fixes in our staging environment.

Ask: would Redwood consider a 14-day extension to our test window, plus some engineering support (ideally 20–40 hours) to help triage and confirm the KV/prefix behavior? Our success criteria are:
- Consistent latency < 220ms p95 for calls matching our production prompt lengths
- No token duplication when using our cache keys
- End-to-end telemetry in our observability pipeline (Datadog) tied to request IDs

We understand this is an ask — if there are alternative packaging options (credits, short-term SKU top-up, or a small price concession) we are open to options. Procurement is ready to sign a small addendum if we can agree terms this week.

I attached a quick usage snapshot from the past 10 days.

Best,
Alicia

Head of AI Integrations, Finora
Alicia.Gomez@finora.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick ask: 2-week pilot extension + engineering help?

Hi Alicia — really appreciate the clear success criteria. Short answer: yes, we can support you, and we have two practical pathways depending on what you prefer from a commercial and operational perspective.

Option 1 — Timebox Booster (14 days):
- Add 14 calendar days to the existing pilot window.
- No additional token charge for the extension.
- Offer: 10% pilot discount on overage token rate for the extended window.
- Redwood provides up to 16 hours of troubleshooting help (remote syncs + engineering triage) at no charge. Extra hours would be charged at our partner rate.

Option 2 — Token Voucher + Scoped Hours:
- Issue a 100,000 token voucher (usable during or after the current pilot).
- Redwood provides 24 hours of dedicated engineering support (split between root-cause triage and an on-call week for deployment verification).
- Voucher does not expire for 60 days; discount on further purchased tokens can be discussed for longer commitments.

A couple of notes:
- If Finora is willing to convert the pilot into a 12-month committed seat pool by Dec 1, we can increase complimentary engineering to 40 hours and a 15% discount on the initial committed month. (This is our standard conversion concession.)
- For either option we will prepare a short addendum (standard legal language) that confirms dates, deliverables, and a limited SLA for the extension window.

I've attached a one-page options summary to make approvals easier. Could you let me know which option your procurement prefers? Happy to jump on a 20-min call to finalize.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Karthik / Priya — quick internal note before I confirm with Alicia. Finora is a high-value mid-market account; they've been testing with Voyager-XL and current burn is modest but frontloaded. They want either 14 extra days or tokens + hours. My read: they prefer engineering hours but procurement likes bounded financials (voucher/credits).

Numbers:
- 100k token voucher ~ list value $450 (our blended cost ~ $60 after batching/quantization savings)
- 16 hours engineering (prod triage) internal cost = ~ $2.5k fully-burdened; 40 hours = ~$6k

Recommendation:
- Offer Option 2 as the primary customer-facing package (100k voucher + 24 hours). It maps to their procurement preference and keeps financial exposure low.
- If they push for free hours, we can escalate to 40 hours waived if they sign a 12-month commitment by Dec 1 (deal_id FIN-POC-2027-089). That concession should be approved by RevOps and Sales Leadership — countersign required.
- Approve a 10% coupon on overage rate for the extended window; keep the 15% conversion discount conditional on committed ARR.

Ask: Priya — can you confirm RevOps is comfortable with the 24 hour + 100k voucher package and the conditional 40-hour concession? Karthik — any objections on margin math or regional constraints?

Thanks,
Connor
